proposed_capability: P95/P124 and P82/P07/P08 Trifecta: protect a player's multi-target gardening intention from verified unsolicited Sims autonomy (especially social chat), retain per-plant fertilizer progress, and re-observe before resumption through the existing host listener/stack. This is bounded planning, not a cancel/click authority or new daemon.
player_save_control_impact: No save/game mutation, new background process, direct click, forced cancellation, mouse movement, or inferred object completion. Explicit player choices, urgent needs and obligations outrank resumption. Existing screen_admit and owner/idle gates remain mandatory.
expected_outcome: Tim's player-authored fertilize-all task retains stable ordered plant targets across a verified autonomous social interruption. Already queued actions are not duplicated. Unknown cause/scene/targets require fresh observation, and no target is completed without independent outcome proof. Only one currently visible interaction can be planned for the next incomplete plant, with explicit control prohibition.
negative_tests: Player change of plan or live player command yields; no cancel or retry
Verified auto-social while garden pending yields recoverable interruption with no input authorization
Stale/unverified queue or unknown origin cannot justify a cancel
Existing queued fertilization is left intact, not duplicated
Completed plants require outcome evidence; partial retries preserve count and ordering
Missing current affordance or mismatched capture cannot produce a click target
Urgent needs, homework and school remain higher priority
Legacy gardening observations without task-continuity remain behaviorally unchanged
Repeated identical observation is idempotent; output remains bounded
rollback_path: Revert the isolated branch after validation; leave user saves, game install, prior certified profiles and runtime state untouched.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact live Sims 4 queue introspection, autonomous-origin evidence, fertilization affordance and completion cues require local Windows game inspection
No live game capture or native patch-certified behavior is available to this cloud connector runtime
